response.overview: Banished from the city, Veiks and Tambet move into a forest. Does anyone even know the way out? Even if the viewer might find this story difficult to follow, is it in the end logical and understandable, real? ... genius? After a great opening, combinations of sketches flow freely towards a punchline. This is harmony. Amazing performers, dizzying situations, masterful execution all delivered via a home video format. Not something you see every day...
response.title: Veiks ja Tambet ... ohu jälgedel
